text.en: 1. This Notification is the Destitute Persons (Welfare Homes) Notification 2017 and comes into operation on 1 November 2017.

2. The Minister establishes MWS Christalite Methodist Home, at 51 Marsiling Drive, Singapore 739297, as a welfare home for the reception, care and rehabilitation of destitute persons, with effect from 1 November 2017.

heading.en: Amendment of Destitute Persons (Welfare Homes) (Consolidation) Notification

text.en: 3. Item (8) of the Destitute Persons (Welfare Homes) (Consolidation) Notification (N 1) is deleted.
